content.scope: The quoted scope below covers every department built into this proposal — confirm final quantities and placement with your producer.

inclusions.title: Main Stage Audio & Control
items: L'Acoustics Kara II line array with KS28 subs and LA-Rack amplification
Yamaha DM7C console with Rio3224 stage box
Wireless mic package with ClearCom intercom system
Monitor and front-fill package for stage performers
Band mic, DI and stage power kit

inclusions.title: Lighting, Video & Staging
items: Robe, Elation and Chauvet fixtures for uplighting, wash, key light and effects
GrandMA3 lighting control with networked nodes
Twin Absen LED walls with Novastar processing
Main stage, video wall, camera and FOH risers with rail, stairs and skirting

inclusions.title: VIP Plaza & Logistics
items: Astera AX5 uplighting and custom gobo projection for the VIP plaza
Dedicated crew for staging setup, AV setup, show and strike
Trucking to and from Ford Center at The Star

moments.label: main stage
moments.title: Where the pick is announced
moments.body: A dedicated main stage with safety railing, stairs and skirting anchors the room, backed by a flown line array and subs that give the announcement presence and weight. Wireless mics and an intercom package keep hosts, talent and the show-caller connected, while key and wash lighting frame the stage so every round has a clear focal point.
highlights: Flown PA gives the announcement weight and presence
Wireless mic and intercom package for hosts and crew
Key and wash lighting frame the stage moment

moments.label: video
moments.title: The room watches together
moments.body: Two ground-supported LED walls flank the stage, giving fans a shared view of every pick, graphic and reaction as it happens. Fed through a dedicated processing chain, the walls are built to hold focus through a long, pacing-driven evening, turning individual reactions into one collective moment for the room.
highlights: Twin LED walls flank the stage
Dedicated processing chain for wall content
Built to hold focus through a long program

moments.label: VIP plaza
moments.title: An atmosphere that keeps building
moments.body: Out on the plaza and concourse, uplighting and custom gobo projection give VIP guests their own distinct atmosphere, separate from the bowl's energy but tied to the same night. It's a space built for movement between picks — a place to gather and talk that still feels connected to the main event.
highlights: Custom gobo projection sets a branded tone
A pace-friendly space between bowl moments

content.heroEyebrow: Draft night at Ford Center — every pick, shared live
content.experience: Picture the draft moving through three connected spaces — the stage where the pick lands, the walls where the room takes it in together, and the plaza where VIPs keep the night going.
content.summary: Draft Party asks a lot of one room: an announcement fans feel together, screens that put every pick and reaction in front of the whole crowd, and a VIP plaza that keeps the energy going between picks. The quoted PA, LED and lighting systems for Ford Center Field are built to carry that excitement from open to the final selection.

schedule.title: Build and systems check
schedule.body: Staging and AV crews load in and align the stage, LED walls, audio and lighting systems ahead of the event, with exact call times still to be confirmed.

schedule.title: Live program
schedule.body: The main stage, video walls and VIP plaza run together through the event, supporting each pick as it's announced.

schedule.title: Strike and de-prep
schedule.body: Crews strike the stage and technical systems and return equipment to prep, with final timing to be confirmed against the venue's schedule.

responsibilities.label: planning
responsibilities.title: Confirming the design
responsibilities.body: Our team finalizes the audio, video, lighting and rigging plan against Ford Center Field's bowl and plaza, aligning power, rigging points and crew schedule with the venue ahead of load-in.

responsibilities.label: build
responsibilities.title: Staging and AV setup
responsibilities.body: Staging crew builds the stage, risers and drape package, then a crew chief, audio and lighting technicians and a video wall technician load in and align the PA, LED walls, lighting rig and distro before showtime.

responsibilities.label: show
responsibilities.title: Running the draft
responsibilities.body: A show-caller and stage manager run the program in real time, keeping audio, video and lighting cues tracking the pacing of each round as picks are announced.

responsibilities.label: strike
responsibilities.title: Clearing the venue
responsibilities.body: Following the program, AV and staging crews strike and reset the space, returning Ford Center Field to the venue, with final strike timing subject to venue confirmation.

content.valueStatement: You get a draft night your fans feel in the room together — sound, screens and light that track every pick, while your team stays focused on the guests, not the gear.

valuePillars.label: fan experience
valuePillars.title: A night fans feel together
valuePillars.body: The line array and subs give the announcement real weight in the room, and the twin LED walls put every pick, graphic and reaction where fans can watch it as one crowd. Stage lighting shapes the stage and the space around it, so the room reads clearly as each round builds toward the next name called.

valuePillars.label: peace of mind
valuePillars.title: A build your team doesn't have to manage
valuePillars.body: Stage, video, audio, lighting, rigging and power come together as one quoted production for Ford Center Field, with a crew chief, show-caller and technicians handling setup, show and strike. That coordination is carried by our crew, so your team can stay focused on the guests and the program instead of the technical build.
